name: 07095 · Woodbridge, NJ
findings: ZIP 07095 (Woodbridge) has 110 nonprofit organizations. 48 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 40 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07095 (Woodbridge) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 07095 (Woodbridge) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
